daily-triage.title: Daily triage
daily-triage.posture: Read-only scan → short report; no feature folder unless a fix ships
daily-triage.description: Inbox, issues, and open threads pile up — produce a prioritized snapshot without coding.
constraints: One pattern per session — no mixing with dependency sweeps
Read-only until owner approves a fix scope
Cap output to one screen of findings
stop_rules: Stop after the report is written
Escalate to feature-init only when owner picks an item to ship
suggested_steps: Scan open issues / PR comments / failing CI badges
classify-change on any fix candidate before Specify

pr-babysitter.title: PR babysitter
pr-babysitter.posture: Watch CI on open PRs; propose minimal fixes
pr-babysitter.description: Open PRs waiting on CI — diagnose failures and suggest the smallest fix.
constraints: One PR at a time
No scope expansion beyond the PR intent
Prefer Medium tier with tasks when the fix touches 3+ files
stop_rules: Stop when CI is green or owner defers
suggested_steps: List open PRs and failing checks
If fix needs spec/tasks → feature-init or append tasks on existing feature

ci-sweeper.title: CI sweeper
ci-sweeper.posture: Cautious fixes — one failure at a time
ci-sweeper.description: Main branch or default pipeline is red or flaky — restore green before new features.
constraints: Fix the first failing job only
Record discrimination sensor notes when behavior changes
No drive-by refactors
stop_rules: Hand off to feature loop if root cause needs product spec
suggested_steps: Run quality-checks or project test command
Isolate the failing step from CI logs

dependency-sweeper.title: Dependency sweeper
dependency-sweeper.posture: Patch-only bumps; run full test suite
dependency-sweeper.description: Outdated packages — apply patch/minor bumps with tests.
constraints: Patch (and agreed minor) only — no major without owner
One ecosystem at a time (npm OR pip, not both)
Lockfile commits are atomic
stop_rules: Stop after one bump wave passes tests
Defer breaking upgrades to a Specify feature
suggested_steps: Audit outdated deps (npm outdated / pip list --outdated)

changelog-drafter.title: Changelog drafter
changelog-drafter.description: Before release — draft CHANGELOG / release notes from merged PRs.
constraints: No code changes
Link PR numbers and owner-facing outcomes
Match semver section in CHANGELOG
stop_rules: Stop when draft is ready for owner review
Owner publishes — agent never npm publish

post-merge-cleanup.title: Post-merge cleanup
post-merge-cleanup.posture: Dead code, TODOs, format — stay inside merged scope
post-merge-cleanup.description: After a large merge — hygiene pass without new features.
constraints: Only files touched by the merge
No behavior changes without tests
Quick tier unless scope grows
stop_rules: Stop after validate-quick or owner says done
Promote to Medium if 4+ files need logic changes
suggested_steps: Review merge diff for stray TODOs and debug logs

issue-triage.title: Issue triage
issue-triage.description: Backlog grooming — organize issues without implementing.
constraints: No code commits
Propose feature slugs for ROADMAP candidates
Use Explore, not Execute
stop_rules: Stop when triage report is written
Elicit only when owner picks an issue to specify
